name: WORKERS_25_ORANGE_WHITE_LONG

sa_t1-sa120_worker.desc: worker with shovel and spoil heap (T1-5 modified), 550 x 470

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet T1-SA120: T1-SA120A 1200 x 600 illustrated (B 1800 x 900, shown smaller). One board in two parts: left 750 x 600 'T1-5A mod.' — orange with a 20 black border, worker symbol 550 x 470 (100 / 550 / 100, 60 from the top, 70 from the bottom) traced from the sheet's filled artwork; right 450 x 600 white 'R4-1A mod.' — red ring measured 446 outer diameter, 45 wide, centred (975, 300), numerals 25 measured 183 high: drawn 180 Series D (the pair measures 281 wide, as Series D), centred in the ring. The ring and numeral sizes are not dimensioned on the sheet (measured at 1200 dpi). The 25 km/h workers limit is the sign's fixed legend.
